major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Summon him on cooldown once you know the fight lasts another 25 seconds, then cram as many Blackout Kick and Breath of Fire casts as you can into the window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 132578 is both the cast and the self aura seen in 5/5 parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Exploding Keg
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it when Keg Smash is below a full charge, with Rushing Jade Wind already ticking, and follow it with the Keg Smash its reset hands you.

major_cooldowns.name: Chi Burst
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown, and open with it from maximum range while you run in to your target.

major_cooldowns.name: Black Ox Brew
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it only once both Purifying Brew charges and your Celestial Brew or Celestial Infusion are down and your Energy is low, then spend a brew straight away.

major_cooldowns.name: Touch of Death
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Snipe it the moment an enemy drops below your own maximum health, and pop Fortifying Brew first to raise that threshold.

defensives.name: Purifying Brew
defensives.usage_rule: Spend a charge right after a damage spike, and never leave both charges sitting ready.

defensives.name: Celestial Infusion
defensives.usage_rule: Press it into steady incoming damage to keep the absorb rolling, and as Master of Harmony spend it often to cash in stored vitality for damage.

defensives.name: Celestial Brew
defensives.usage_rule: Take it into spiky damage and time it onto the big hit, because the whole shield is spent in 8 seconds.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses; the field runs Celestial Infusion in its slot.

defensives.name: Fortifying Brew
defensives.usage_rule: Use it before your health gets dangerous, since Keg Smash and Tiger Palm cut its 6 minute cooldown roughly in half.
defensives.id_note: 115203 is the cast id; 120954 is the self aura in the parses.

defensives.name: Expel Harm
defensives.usage_rule: Press it to sweep up your Healing Spheres when you need self healing, and leave them alone while Niuzao's Resolve is turning them into a steady stream.
defensives.id_note: Table base_cd_s is 15s; the guide text calls it a 5 second cooldown.

defensives.name: Dampen Harm
defensives.usage_rule: Press it before a run of large hits, because it cuts the biggest ones hardest.
defensives.id_note: 122278 is the castable id; 175395 shares the name and neither was observed in the parses.

defensives.name: Diffuse Magic
defensives.usage_rule: Press it into heavy magic damage to cut it and throw harmful effects back at their caster.

defensives.name: Zen Meditation
defensives.usage_rule: Channel it through a scripted magic burst you can stand still for, since a melee hit ends it early.

rules.description: Keep Shuffle up at all times
rules.action: Chain Keg Smash and Blackout Kick on cooldown so it never lapses, because staggered damage keeps landing after it falls off.

rules.description: Keep Breath of Fire burning on your target
rules.action: Refresh it every cooldown and use the Keg Smash resets from Sal'salabim's Strength to keep Charred Passions on your Blackout Kicks.

rules.description: Spend Empty Barrel on a free Keg Smash
rules.action: Fire the free Keg Smash as soon as the barrel appears, and hold your brews until it is gone.

rules.description: Open Keg Smash to Blackout Kick, then Niuzao
rules.action: Build Shuffle with Keg Smash and Blackout Kick first, take Breath of Fire for Charred Passions, and summon Niuzao on the next free global.

rules.description: Follow Black Ox Brew with Purifying Brew
rules.action: Spend a Purifying Brew charge immediately afterwards so the recharge starts again.

rules.description: Save Energy for Keg Smash before Tiger Palm
rules.action: Bank enough Energy for the next Keg Smash and dump the rest into Tiger Palm only when you are near capping or consuming Blackout Combo.

source_summary: Brewmaster presses Blackout Kick and Keg Smash on cooldown to hold Shuffle at full uptime, then fills the gaps with Breath of Fire, Tiger Palm and its cooldowns. Invoke Niuzao and Exploding Keg go out on cooldown rather than being stacked together, with Exploding Keg feeding an extra Keg Smash and Niuzao paying out for every Blackout Kick and Breath of Fire inside its 25 second window. Purifying Brew, Celestial Infusion and Fortifying Brew are spent freely because Keg Smash and Tiger Palm cut every Brew cooldown roughly in half.
